description: This file defines the class UserPrincipal, which implements Spring Security's UserDetails interface to represent authenticated user information and authorities.

classes.name: UserPrincipal
classes.description: A class implementing UserDetails for Spring Security, encapsulating user identity and authorities.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns the authorities granted to the user based on authGroups.

methods.name: isAccountNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's account is non-expired.

methods.name: isAccountNonLocked
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's account is non-locked.

methods.name: isCredentialsNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the user's credentials are non-expired.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is enabled.
